summary:
I wrote src/main.ts, and it passes the typecheck. I did not run `vite build` or open the scene in a browser, so the rendering is unchecked.

The robot is built from primitives (capsule limbs, box torso and pelvis, sphere head) in a joint hierarchy. It has hips, chest, head, two shoulders, two elbows and two knees as articulated joints. A per-frame sine animation drives breathing, weight shift, head turn, and gentle arm and knee motion, so frames differ over time.

The lighting is a shadow-casting key directional light and a magenta rim light, on a `#05060a` background with a low-intensity neutral environment and light bloom. A floor plane receives the shadows. A perspective camera at [0.9, 1.3, 5.2] looks at [0, 1, 0] to frame the whole robot. `window.__EVAL_READY__` is set after `app.ready()`.
